lemmas.name: sorted_perm
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l : List Int), List.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) (l.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b))) ∧ List.isPerm l (l.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a ≤ b))) = true
lemmas.proof:
by intro l
  exact ⟨List.pairwise_mergeSort' (· ≤ ·) l, List.isPerm_iff.mpr (List.mergeSort_perm l _).symm⟩
